inputs.text: In Palakkad on March 28, Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan rejected allegations of Rs 700 crore corruption over the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project, describing them as political. Whatever the political framing, public money and systems serving cooperative members deserve transparent scrutiny—not just competing accusations that leave ordinary people with no clear answers.
